subject: [PATCH 3/7] SUNRPC: keep the first error in svc_register()

2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch modifies the svc_register() function in the SUNRPC module to keep track of the first error encountered during RPC program registration, rather than overwriting it with subsequent errors. This change is necessary because the current behavior can lead to unexpected results when registering multiple programs, particularly in cases where some programs fail to register but others succeed. The patch ensures that only the first error is returned, which helps to prevent issues such as a server failing to bring up any listeners due to a partial failure during registration.
